narrative.overview:
Pixbooth is a quiet, modern photo instrument: generous space, clear monochrome controls, and one primary decision on each screen. The camera and finished keepsake carry the visual weight; controls stay legible and secondary. Creative media and authored artwork keep their actual colors.

The accepted modernization brief and direction contract supersede the earlier neobrutalist world. The supplied logo, bundled DM Sans, original assets, media geometry, and photo/live capabilities remain. The canonical working project is C:\Martin Archive\Programming\2026 Projects\PhotoPix.
keyCharacteristics: Six neutral interface colors with content colors preserved.
Bundled DM Sans with a clear, readable hierarchy.
An 8px spacing rhythm and restrained 8â€“12px working corners.
Camera-first capture and an artifact-first editor.

rules.name: The Chrome Rule
rules.body: Use the six normative interface tokens. Captured media, authored frame textures, background swatches, and sticker artwork retain their actual colors; never desaturate the page root to enforce chrome neutrality.

rules.name: The Focus Rule
rules.body: Every interactive state has a visible keyboard focus treatment. Selected templates show a stronger border and check; selected tools expose pressed or selected semantics as well as their visual state.

dos: Do use the current frontmatter and modern stylesheet for new interface work.
Do preserve the supplied logo, bundled font, creative artwork, and media geometry.
Do keep source camera frames contained and exported media center-cropped to template openings.
Do explain unavailable actions and recovery in concise nearby copy.
Do preserve keyboard operation, focus return, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't restore hard action shadows, the landing grid, or the retired neobrutalist chrome.
Don't flatten media colors or substitute placeholder captures for a live user session.
Don't claim browser, device, camera, export, or accessibility conformance from source-only checks.

black.purpose: Chrome text, outlines, inverted selection, and major actions. Content artwork retains user-selected colors.

white.purpose: Chrome canvas and unselected surfaces. Ramp metadata is a neutral preview, not an expanded interface palette.

display.purpose: Centered home-page message; 60px at compact desktop heights and clamp(38px,10vw,48px) on mobile.

shadows.name: action-offset
shadows.purpose: Major dark CTAs only; camera and ordinary panels remain shadow-free.

motion.name: primary-press
motion.purpose: Compress the primary action's hard shadow; disabled for reduced motion.

focus.name: inverted-segment
focus.purpose: Keyboard focus within selected dark segmented controls.

extensions.paletteScope: Black/white chrome only; captured media and user-selected creative designs keep their colors. Tonal-ramp previews are metadata, not allowed chrome colors.

landing.composition: User-pinned centered headline, short two-line copy, primary Capture action, and illustrative photo-print arrangement. No interactive playground.
landing.navigation: No landing navbar. Supplied logo centered above hero headline; one Capture button enters Classic strip.
landing.background: User-requested 32px grid of 1px black lines (#0001) on white; landing only.
landing.captureHover: White with black text and arrow by default; black with white text and arrow on hover.
landing.rotationScope: Fixed photo artifacts only; no tilted UI badges or animated artifacts.
landing.responsive: Desktop strip/central print/small print plus five-second note. Mobile keeps strip/central print and hides the right ornament.
landing.supportingSections: Formats ribbon and three sequential native ordered-list how-to rows.

workflow.entry: Landing Capture opens #/templates. Classic strip is selected initially.
workflow.navigation: Non-home pages share an ordered step nav. Current link uses aria-current=step; unavailable future steps are non-link text with aria-disabled=true. Previous available steps remain links.
workflow.availability: Capture requires Continue; editing requires the complete capture count.
workflow.selection: Step one has 21 proportional template diagrams and capture counts, a selected-layout summary, and Continue. Four catalog columns >=1200px, three on narrower desktop, two on tablet/mobile; summary stacks on mobile.
workflow.capture: Step two has a face-sticker-only sidebar, full flexible camera, two-column captured-media gallery, and native collapsible settings. Initial templates are not in this sidebar.
workflow.editing: Step three has compatible same-count layouts, backgrounds, filters, border artwork, caption, and JPG/MP4 download controls.
workflow.state: Captures and editor settings persist through backtracking/history in memory. Capture layout locks after the first item. Start over clears captures/editor choices, returns to step one, and leaves camera off.
workflow.guards: Fresh/reloaded #/booth and #/edit without session state redirect to #/templates. In-session edit before completion returns to capture if Continue was used.
workflow.cleanup: Navigation away from capture stops camera tracks and cancels countdown/recording.

narrative.overview:
The four user-supplied neobrutalist references establish bold type, sharp frames, dense useful groups, and explicit states. The earlier pale-blue dotted, generously rounded PhotoPix world is superseded. The canonical project remains `C:\Martin Archive\Programming\2026 Projects\PhotoPix`.

The additional [landing composition reference](docs/design/references/landing-composition.png) pins the centered home-page hero as a user-approved composition. It does not replace the site's typography, palette, sharp controls, or camera behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Bold bundled DM Sans with compact, useful hierarchy.
Sharp frames with square or subtly softened 0â€“4px edges.
Clear outlined groups and high-contrast selected states.
Hard offset shadows reserved for major actions.
An expansive, shadow-free camera and media-led editor.

rules.name: The Chrome Rule
rules.body: Interface surfaces, text, outlines, and states use only the black and white tokens. Do not import the reference images' accent colors. Captured media and user-selected backgrounds, filters, face effects, and border artwork retain their content colors; never apply global desaturation.

rules.name: The Action Shadow Rule
rules.body: Major dark actions use a crisp `4px 4px 0 #000` shadow and compress by translating 4px on press. The camera remains shadow-free. Panels, gallery cards, option tiles, and outline actions rely on borders rather than ambient depth.

dos: Do apply the concept across home, booth, editor, loading, error, and empty states.
Do distinguish monochrome interface chrome from colorful creative content.
Do keep full source frames in the live preview and center-crop output into template frames.
Do preserve visible actions, keyboard focus, and native disclosure behavior.
donts: Don't restore blue dots, soft panel shadows, or broad rounded cards.
Don't copy shopping carts, pricing, product imagery, reference copy, or third-party component code.
